quote: DSI transforms the retrieval task into sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) modeling, using queries as inputs and relevant document identifiers (DocIDs) as generation targets.
Generative retrieval seeks to replace the entire information retrieval process with a single sequence-to-sequence model capable of mapping queries directly to relevant document identifiers.
